answer_1.quote: We examine how LLMs understand differences in aspect by presenting LLMs with narratives that have a key word either in the imperfective or perfective (e.g., "was passing" vs. "passed") followed by comprehension probes adapted from previous human studies.
datasets: narratives adapted from linguistic research on aspect comprehension in English
answer_1.outputs: LLM responses to narrative comprehension probes including truth value judgments, word completion, and causal inference questions
